body.name: Labelwise joint-Wald profiles
body.construction: Partition \(E_j\widetilde\Omega_nE_j^{\top}\) as \(\begin{pmatrix}\widehat V_{j,n}&\widehat u_{j,n}\\\widehat u_{j,n}^{\top}&\widehat v_{j,n}\end{pmatrix}\), compute \(\widehat\gamma_{j,n}=\widehat V_{j,n}^{-1}\widehat u_{j,n}\), \(\widehat\sigma_{j,n}^2=\widehat v_{j,n}-\widehat u_{j,n}^{\top}\widehat V_{j,n}^{-1}\widehat u_{j,n}\), \(Q_{j,n}=n\widehat s_{j,n}^{\top}\widehat V_{j,n}^{-1}\widehat s_{j,n}\), and \(\widehat c_n=c_{1-\alpha}(\widetilde\Omega_n)\). If \(Q_{j,n}\le\widehat c_n^2\), set \(I_{j,n}(\alpha)=[\widehat b_{j,n}-\widehat\gamma_{j,n}^{\top}\widehat s_{j,n}\;\pm\;n^{-1/2}\widehat\sigma_{j,n}(\widehat c_n^2-Q_{j,n})^{1/2}]\); otherwise set \(I_{j,n}(\alpha)=\varnothing\).
